description:
Report on the ~0.7 sq km area at a point in India: what land costs, how fast it is being built on, and the price outlook.

Use for questions like "how fast is Whitefield growing", "what is the
govt. land rate in Karumuru", "is this locality built out". Give `place`
or both `lat` and `lon` (coordinates are exact; a name takes the best
match). Returns: price today and what kind of price it is (city-wide
average, govt. plot rate, or none), price outlook per year with a 5-year
range, share of ground built on, building growth over 5 years, building
count and height, the state's govt. plot and farmland rates with their
year, nearby asking prices where listed, a reliability grade, and a link
to the area's page with the charts. Covers India only.

place.description: A place name, e.g. 'Whitefield Bengaluru'. Used when lat/lon are not given; takes the best match and says so if the name is ambiguous.
